card.text: Explore Bennu in 3D with cssEarth using mission-derived shape and surface data.

introduction.text: Bennu is a dark, boulder-covered asteroid explored by OSIRIS-REx. Its laser-altimeter shape reveals an equatorial ridge and an irregular surface. The mission returned samples to Earth in 2023.

normal.title: PolyCam reflectance mosaic
normal.summary: Corrected reflectance covers roughly 55° north to 55° south. The gray grid marks the unobserved polar regions.

surface.title: PolyCam 5 cm image basemap
surface.summary: The 5 cm basemap retains photographed shadows. Its control shape differs from the display mesh, so small offsets remain.

spectral.title: MapCam spectral composite
spectral.summary: Published false-color MapCam composite. Colors emphasize spectral differences; gray grid marks missing coverage, including both poles.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 241 m sphere, from the shape model. Colors include Bennu's broad form; the outline is simplified.
